# Capsa Agent Cookbook

> Recipes and installable skills for using the Capsa MCP connector — a read-mostly context API for field-service operations — together with email, docs, and calendar to finish real work. Capsa supplies context and records approved completion; the agent drafts and the user approves before anything is sent.

Capability availability and filter values are resolved live from each connection. Before acting, call `capsa_describe_service` and `capsa_list_capabilities`; this file lists what the cookbook documents, not what a given connection has enabled. A structured version of this map is in [index.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/main/index.json).

## Start here

- [Start here](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/start-here.md): What an agent can do, the orient → resolve → act → record → log loop, the safety contract, and example prompts to try.
- [Orientation skill](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/skills/capsa-orientation/SKILL.md): Installable, discovery-first orientation — load before any request that touches Capsa data.

## Skills

- [proposal-followup-batch](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/skills/proposal-followup-batch/SKILL.md): Clear a batch of outstanding proposal follow-ups — draft per contact, review, send via a connected email provider, mark done only on send evidence.
- [sensitive-visit-notice](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/skills/sensitive-visit-notice/SKILL.md): Draft customer pre-notices for upcoming visits flagged sensitive (e.g. chemical application); the user approves each before sending.
- [renewal-portfolio-triage](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/skills/renewal-portfolio-triage/SKILL.md): Pull the renewal book for a scope, tier it with explainable rules, and present a ranked worklist the user prunes before any deep dive.
- [renewal-deep-dive](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/skills/renewal-deep-dive/SKILL.md): Build a renewal recommendation for one property — price/hours/terms options with cited evidence; the agent proposes, the user decides.
- [meeting-notes-to-command-center](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/skills/meeting-notes-to-command-center/SKILL.md): Turn AI meeting notes (Granola, Fathom, Otter, or pasted text) into a reviewed Command Center property note — resolve the property via the primary contact, confirm the exact property and note text, then write it.
- [property-site-update](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/skills/property-site-update/SKILL.md): Pull a property's relationship, health, satisfaction, and outstanding-item context, then draft an internal brief and a customer-safe update for the property manager — what happened, what's upcoming, what's needed from them. The agent never sends.
- [property-plan-builder](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/skills/property-plan-builder/SKILL.md): Build or evolve a property's forward-looking plan with the user from health, satisfaction, planning, and pipeline context plus any existing future-plans notes, then save the approved text as a Command Center property note flagged for future plans. Internal by default — the agent never sends it to the customer.
- [job-book-review](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/skills/job-book-review/SKILL.md): Scan and rank a branch/division's active (WIP) job book by health or margin erosion, shortlist the jobs worth a closer look, then pull a compact card and targeted drilldowns per job and draft a review memo.
- [property-book-triage](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/skills/property-book-triage/SKILL.md): Start with the fixed "what needs my attention today" queue, broaden with a configurable metric sweep over the property book, then hand the shortlist to a follow-up, note, or renewal recipe.
- [budget-item-change](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/skills/budget-item-change/SKILL.md): Propose a create or edit to a property's budget item, review near-duplicate warnings, and save only after explicit approval. A saved item is live in Command Center planning immediately, not a draft.
- [price-recommendation-change](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/skills/price-recommendation-change/SKILL.md): Propose a create or edit to a property's price increase recommendation, review near-duplicate warnings, and save only after explicit approval. Every save stays a draft for a person to review in Command Center.
- [scorecard-review](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/skills/scorecard-review/SKILL.md): Confirm the metric, dimension, and date basis with the analytics catalog, run an Ops or Sales Scorecard query, drill into a specific cell, and bring in property-level penetration/profitability context.

## Reference

- [Follow-up actions](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/reference/capabilities/followup-actions.md): Outstanding proposal follow-ups with contact context; evidence-gated completion.
- [Upcoming visits](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/reference/capabilities/upcoming-visits.md): Scheduled visits with property and customer-contact context for notice workflows.
- [Property context](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/reference/capabilities/property-context.md): Search properties and pull production, satisfaction, sales, and visit signals; filter, rank, or triage a property book by dimension, metric, or date range.
- [Job context](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/reference/capabilities/job-context.md): The job-grain equivalent of property context — rank a branch/division's active (WIP) job book, then pull a compact card and ticket/crew/billing/issue/health-history drilldowns for one job.
- [Renewal opportunities](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/reference/capabilities/renewal-opportunities.md): The renewal book for a window — prior contract baseline, pipeline by status, retention, change tags — plus per-property service comparisons and performance review.
- [Command Center notes](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/reference/capabilities/command-center-notes.md): Resolve a property from a meeting's primary contact, confirm the exact property, then write a Command Center property note with an optional Aspire property-note append.
- [Budget planning](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/reference/capabilities/budget-planning.md): Propose a create or edit to a property's budget item, review near-duplicate warnings, and save only after explicit approval — a saved item is live immediately.
- [Price recommendations](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/reference/capabilities/price-recommendations.md): Propose a create or edit to a property's price increase recommendation and save — always as a draft for a person to review — only after explicit approval.
- [Product feedback](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/reference/capabilities/product-feedback.md): Log an unmet request for Capsa product review when the connector can't satisfy it — loop step 5, `capsa_log_feature_request`.
- [Scorecard queries](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/reference/capabilities/scorecard-queries.md): Run supported Ops or Sales Scorecard analytics with explicit dates, metrics, dimensions, and filters, and drill into the rows behind one cell.
- [Property analytics](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/reference/capabilities/property-analytics.md): Run Property Penetrations or Property Profitability by-property reports with explicit dates, filters, and defaults.
- [Resolving ambiguous names](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook/blob/main/reference/patterns/resolve-ambiguous-names.md): Pattern — work out which dimension a user's term means (sales rep? account owner? property?) before filtering or reporting.

## Install

- [Plugin: capsa-cookbook](https://github.com/capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook): Install the skill pack with `/plugin marketplace add capsa-analytics/capsa-agent-cookbook`, then `/plugin install capsa-cookbook@capsa`.
